pageIntro: Security, supply-chain and transparency documents for the platform. Every link here contains public information only; no personal data.

supplyChain.title: Supply chain
supplyChain.sbomNote: The SBOM is produced on every main-branch run as the sbom-cyclonedx artifact of the "Security" CI workflow; it is not served by the application. To download it, open the workflow's latest successful run and take it from the Artifacts section (repository access required).
supplyChain.provenanceNote: SLSA provenance for the standalone build output is generated by the same workflow and kept as an artifact.
supplyChain.scorecardNote: Not published: the repository is currently private and Scorecard only publishes scores for public repositories. The workflow is ready; results will be published automatically once the repository is public.

apis.title: Verification endpoints
apis.jwksNote: ES256 public keys so third parties can verify agent mandates and signed tokens. The private key is never published.
apis.openapiNote: Machine-readable description of all public and authenticated API endpoints; agents and integrations use it for discovery.

policies.title: Policies and transparency
policies.securityNote: Report vulnerabilities through GitHub private security advisories instead of public issues; first response target is 5 business days.
policies.transparencyNote: Notice, removal and appeal counts (no personal data) are exported as JSON/CSV from the compliance dashboard; admin access required.

footnote: Portfolio/demo project; links point to the real workflows and endpoints in the source repository.
